name: The Rubens at the Palace
positioning: Traditional English hotel of the Red Carnation Hotel Collection, directly opposite the Royal Mews at Buckingham Palace
best_for: Travelers who want a base beside Buckingham Palace and Westminster
Families and multi-generational groups wanting connected rooms

facts.text: The hotel is directly opposite the Royal Mews at Buckingham Palace.
It is a five-minute walk from Victoria Station.
The Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, the London Eye and Buckingham Palace are a short stroll away.
The building was built in the 1800s to host debutantes attending parties at the Palace.
The decor is traditional English, with marble floors and crystal chandeliers.
Rooms and suites are filled with antiques and original artwork.
Superior King rooms have a handcrafted, custom-made king Savoir bed.
Family wings combine rooms through a private central door.
The team can prepare cots, high chairs and extra beds in advance and arrange babysitting on request.
The hotel has two restaurants, a lounge overlooking the Royal Mews, two bars and 24-hour room service.
The Cavalry Bar is inspired by royal pageantry, with rich red interiors, inventive cocktails and gin tastings.
Guests can design a bespoke seven-course menu with the Executive Chef, sourcing ingredients at Borough Market.

highlights.text: Royal Mews View rooms overlook the Royal Mews of Buckingham Palace.
The Royal Themed rooms are each themed in honour of past British monarchs.
Through a partnership with Historic Royal Palaces, guests can get complimentary tickets to attractions including the Tower of London, Hampton Court Palace and Kensington Palace.
Afternoon tea is served in the Palace Lounge, with panoramic views over the Royal Mews of Buckingham Palace.
A resident artist, ShelleyTheArtist, can create bespoke personal or family portraits by appointment.

considerations.text: The complimentary Historic Royal Palaces tickets are a limited allocation, offered first-come, first-served and subject to availability.
Interconnecting rooms, interleading rooms and family wings must be booked directly through the hotel's reservations team.
WhataHotel notes the historic building has traditional room layouts.
